items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Lucky Thompson came in behind him... when Ted left the band, Lucky Thompson came in behind him... Lucky been playing about three years when he come with Hamp's band

ctx.x: Oh, you were? It would be duetting with (inaudible) --
Well, I had Elef Simon out of Houston who was duetting with me. I had Lucky Thompson, and I had MacRae. I'm trying to think of MacRae's first --
